source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Bracketed terms is the label that belongs on this item, so 'When a factor multiplies a bracket, multiply that factor by every term' is answered as bracketed terms rather than outside factor.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Bracketed terms is what produces outside factor, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about When a factor multiplies a bracket, multiply that.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: outside factor is settled by running 'To find how a product changes after its factors are adjusted, expand': If ab becomes (a + m)(b + n), then the new product is ab + an + bm + mn, so the change — on the item about When a factor multiplies a bracket, multiply that.

mx.name: operation_confusion
mx.teacher_note: Outside factor is computed by squaring bracketed terms and leaving outside factor linear, so the written value is 33 — on the item about When a factor multiplies a bracket, multiply that.

intelligence.enrichment: For any terms a, b, and c, a(b + c) = ab + ac and a(b - c) = ab - ac; the same distribution applies when the bracket contains more than two terms.
